units.title: Introduction: The Five Key Terms of Dramatism
units.folder: Burke - Introduction (Five Key Terms of Dramatism)
units.role: CENTRAL UNIT (LOAD-BEARING). Burke's primary statement of the pentad (Act / Scene / Agent / Agency / Purpose). Declares grammatical-not-empirical claim of universal applicability. Introduces ratios. Distinguishes grammar (universal) from philosophic-idiom (variable). Apex anchor for the dissertation's motive-analytic apparatus.
units.primary_pentad_role: all five terms in their canonical statement

units.title: Part 1.I — Container and Thing Contained
units.role: CENTRAL UNIT (LOAD-BEARING). The 10 dyadic ratios developed in full. Container/contained as primary spatial metaphor. Ibsen *Enemy of the People* + O'Neill *Mourning Becomes Electra* worked examples. 'Ubiquity of the ratios' + 'range of all the ratios' as Burke's claim that ratios are the analytical engine.

units.title: Part 1.II — Antinomies of Definition
units.role: Substance vocabulary — paradox of substance; contextual / familial / dialectical / dialectic-of-tragedy substance; actus/status; intrinsic/extrinsic; rhetoric of substance; centrality of substance. Distinct analytical apparatus alongside the pentad. Seeds the gm-substance-vocabulary synthesis deliverable.
units.ocr_notes: PDF p.42 raw text shows 'std' for 'sta-' (Indo-Germanic root 'stā' / 'stand'); ABBYY OCR drops macron and dehyphenates. Italic 'std' renders unbolded. Period-substitution observed: 'explicidy' for 'explicitly', 'sufficiendy' for 'sufficiently' — italic-tl ligature problem.

units.title: Part 1.III — Scope and Reduction
units.role: Longest Part 1 chapter. Representative anecdote (methodological apparatus); circumference (the scope of scene); way of creation; act as locus of motives; pantheism and ontology; grammatical steps to naturalism; monetary reduction (long case study). Two of Burke's most dissertation-deployable methodological constructs (representative anecdote + circumference) developed here.
units.primary_pentad_role: act as locus of motives (book pp. 64-69); circumference as scene-scoping (book pp. 77-85)

units.title: Part 2.I — Scene
units.role: Scene as featuring-principle of materialism — Hobbes (pp.131ff), Spinoza (alignment of terms), Darwin, Lucretius+Epicurus, Stoicism. Includes 'Rhetorical and Symbolic Levels' subsection. Direct cite chain to materialist lineage.
units.primary_pentad_role: Scene as featured term in materialism

units.title: Part 2.II — Agent in General
units.role: Agent as featuring-principle of idealism — Berkeley, Hume, Leibniz, Kant (moral transcendence; 1st/2nd/3rd Critiques), Idealism after Kant, Hegel, Marxism, Communist Manifesto, Lenin. The full idealism-to-historical-materialism lineage as an Agent-featuring tradition. 56 pp.
units.primary_pentad_role: Agent as featured term in idealism

units.title: Part 2.III — Act
units.role: Act as featuring-principle of realism (scholastic realism). Aristotle (pp.227-232, 242-243, 252-254, 275-276) + Aquinas (pp.227-232, 254, 281). Pathetic fallacy; incipient and delayed action; realist family vs. nominalist aggregate; act/potency; psychology of action. **EXEGETICAL bridge** to existing Aristotle Complete Works + Phantasia Cluster indices.
units.primary_pentad_role: Act as featured term in realism (EXEGETICAL)
exegetical_bridge_to: Heidegger - Basic Concepts of Aristotelian Philosophy

units.title: Part 2.IV — Agency and Purpose
units.role: Combined treatment. AGENCY: philosophy of means / pragmatism / James / Dewey / Mead / symbolic of agency / purposive agencies of applied science. PURPOSE: Aristotle / Platonist / mysticism (Plotinus + Bonaventura) / silence and the hunt / mysticism of means / rationalism and verbal medium / means and ends of this Grammar.
units.primary_pentad_role: Agency as featured in pragmatism; Purpose as featured in mysticism

units.title: Part 3.I — The Dialectic of Constitutions
units.role: LONGEST CHAPTER (79 pp.). Applied dialectic; necessity for representative case; total war; constitutive vs. admonitory; five basic terms as beginning; anarchism; anarcho-syndicalism; laissez-faire; spectrum of terms between 'freedom' and 'capitalism'; constitutions and the opponent; the dialectics of federation. Also a paradigm of dramatistic applied analysis — methodological template alongside Appendix essays.
units.primary_pentad_role: applied-dramatism walkthrough; all 5 terms + ratios deployed on the constitutional case

units.title: Part 3.II — Dialectic in General
units.role: Transformation of terms; merger and division; dialectic of the scapegoat; per genus et differentiam; variants of merger/division; the mind-body / being-nothing / action-passion pairs; Socratic transcendence; temporizing of essence; dissolution of drama. First-class apparatuses for dramatistic analysis.
units.primary_pentad_role: ratio-transformations + dialectical apparatuses across all 5 terms

units.title: Appendix A — Symbolic Action in a Poem by Keats
units.folder: Burke - Symbolic Action in a Poem by Keats
units.role: Worked dramatistic-analysis of 'Ode on a Grecian Urn'. Methodological template for the dissertation's empirical adaptation chapter. Symbolic-action method demonstrated.
units.primary_pentad_role: applied-dramatism walkthrough on a lyric poem
literary_examples: Keats, Ode on a Grecian Urn

units.title: Appendix B — The Problem of the Intrinsic (as reflected in the Neo-Aristotelian School)
units.folder: Burke - The Problem of the Intrinsic
units.role: Theoretical treatment of intrinsic-vs-extrinsic distinction in critical analysis; engagement with Chicago Neo-Aristotelian school. Clarifies the scope-of-text question that recurs throughout the *Grammar*.

units.title: Appendix C — Motives and Motifs in the Poetry of Marianne Moore
units.folder: Burke - Motives and Motifs in Marianne Moore
units.role: Sustained dramatistic-analysis case study applied to a single poet's *oeuvre*. Methodological template for poet/author-level (or, in dissertation deployment, player/game/community-level) analysis.
units.primary_pentad_role: applied-dramatism walkthrough on a poet's complete oeuvre

units.title: Appendix D — Four Master Tropes
units.role: Metaphor (perspective), Metonymy (reduction), Synecdoche (representation), Irony (dialectic) as four tropes for the discovery and description of 'the truth.' DISTINCT analytical apparatus parallel to the pentad. Dissertation-deployable in its own right; seeds gm-four-master-tropes-manual.

Allen Tate.verdict: PRESENT — Tier-C; GM-13 (Appendix D) Four Master Tropes context.

Heidegger.verdict: WHOLLY ABSENT. Confirms plan §5 Phase 0 hypothesis: Burke 1945 predates English Heidegger reception substantially. Implication: every Heidegger-Burke bridge (BCAP, *Being and Time*) is **ANTICIPATORY-PROJECTION (dissertation)**, NOT exegetical.

Merleau-Ponty.verdict: WHOLLY ABSENT. *Phénoménologie de la perception* (1945) was publication-year coincident; Burke had no access. Implication: every Merleau-Ponty-Burke bridge is anticipatory.

Uexkull/Funktionskreis/Umwelt.verdict: WHOLLY ABSENT. Burke 1945 predates English *Streifzüge* (Schiller 1957 / O'Neil 2010). Implication: Layer C (Uexküll) is wholly **ANTICIPATORY-PROJECTION (dissertation)**. The 'scene ↔ Umwelt' convergence is a theoretically-interesting independent triangulation, NOT an exegetical bridge.

Whitehead.verdict: ABSENT despite Burke's process-philosophy thematics in Part 3.II — surprising; flag for Phase 2 examination of how Burke handles process without explicit Whitehead.

Mannheim.verdict: ABSENT — surprising given Burke's sociology-of-knowledge thematics in GM-08 Constitutions.

Sophocles.verdict: ABSENT (vs. Aeschylus 2 hits; Shakespeare 15) — Burke's tragedy interlocutors are Aeschylus + modern (Ibsen, O'Neill), not classical-Greek-tragic.

Empedocles.verdict: ABSENT — surprising for a Lucretius-Epicurus interlocutor; Burke's pre-Socratic engagement is limited.

Keats.verdict: PRESENT — Tier-A literary example for GM-10 (Appendix A).

Korzybski.verdict: PRESENT — Tier-A; unexpectedly high; the *Science and Sanity* general-semantics interlocutor; pervasive in action/abstracting discussions.

Freud.verdict: PRESENT — Tier-B; concentrated in psychological-motive discussions.
